records.subject: You're in -- let's get Clearwater Media set up
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 and 1 invite sent, so momentum existed, but no key milestone in 6 days and attention is on an unresolved duplicate-charge ticket (tick_5b16f16c874b, email:7b170a98, slack:dd3a892e). No customer reply to two check-ins (email:eb1523d4). 8 days left; moderate-low odds unaided.

draft.subject: Following up on your ticket — and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for your patience on the billing question — your ticket is still open with our team, and Tariq is following up with you directly on the charge and the receipt for accounting.

Separately, I saw you've created your first project and sent an invite, which is a great start. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting your real work in next is usually what makes it click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything.

Best,
Priya
